description.fun: A corgi pup that throws off sparks as it runs: an organ at the base of its tail makes electricity, but Yamper can't store it. It's Galar's favourite herding dog for Wooloo, though only because it's paid in treats. Corgis are famous in Britain as royal pets, fitting for a region based on the UK.
description.guide: An Electric-type puppy Pokémon based on the Welsh corgi, popular in Galar as a herding dog. Yamper generates electricity from the base of its tail when it runs and chases anything fast. It evolves into Boltund.
description.tagline: A sparky corgi that herds Wooloo for treats

description.fun: A greyhound that channels its electricity into its legs, letting it run flat out for three days straight and top 80 km/h. It's Thievul's natural enemy, which may echo fox hunting with English foxhounds. Its Japanese name, Pulsewan, may even nod to Pulseman, a game Game Freak made.
description.guide: The evolution of Yamper, a sleek dog Pokémon based on greyhounds and foxhounds. Boltund sends electricity to its legs to boost their strength and can run faster than 80 km/h. Thievul is its natural enemy.
description.tagline: A lightning-fast greyhound that runs for three days straight
